items.tr: bir şekilde idare etmek, yamalı bohçayla halletmek
items.example: We had no plan, but we managed to muddle through.
items.exampleTr: Hiç planımız yoktu ama bir şekilde idare ettik.
items.simple: You don't really know what you are doing, but you still get it done.
dialogue: A: How was your first week as a manager?
B: Honestly? I just tried to muddle through.
items.note: Planı, bilgisi olmadan 'kıvırıp' halletmek; hafif esprili.

items.example: He tried to palm off his old laptop on me.
items.exampleTr: Eski laptopunu bana kakalamaya çalıştı.
items.simple: Give someone a thing you don't want, and act like it is good.
dialogue: A: Why have you got two printers?
B: My brother wanted to palm off his broken one on me.
items.note: Genelde 'palm something off on someone' kalıbıyla.

items.example: We need to pare down the guest list a bit.
items.exampleTr: Davetli listesini biraz kısmamız lazım.
items.simple: Make something smaller by cutting the bits you don't need.
dialogue: A: Your suitcase won't close.
B: Yeah, I need to pare down what I'm taking.
items.note: Liste, bütçe, eşya için; 'cut down'dan daha titiz bir kısma.

items.example: They just piggyback on our ideas and take the credit.
items.exampleTr: Bizim fikirlerimizin üstüne binip övgüyü onlar alıyor.
items.simple: Use what someone else made to help yourself, without much work.
dialogue: A: Can we use the marketing team's survey?
B: Sure, let's piggyback on their data.
items.note: Hem olumsuz (sırtından geçinmek) hem nötr (üstüne kurmak) olabilir.

items.example: My knee always starts to play up when it rains.
items.exampleTr: Yağmur yağınca dizim hep sızlamaya başlıyor.
items.simple: When a body part or machine stops working well again.
dialogue: A: You're limping.
B: Yeah, my back's started to play up again.
items.note: İngiliz İngilizcesi; diz, sırt, araba, internet için çok yaygın.

items.example: I had to plough through two hundred emails this morning.
items.exampleTr: Bu sabah iki yüz e-postayı zar zor eritmem gerekti.
items.simple: Keep going through a lot of boring stuff until it's done.
dialogue: A: Did you finish the report?
B: I'm still trying to plough through it.
items.note: ABD'de 'plow through'. Okumak, yemek, iş yığını için.

items.example: The kids managed to polish off a whole pizza.
items.exampleTr: Çocuklar koca bir pizzayı silip süpürdü.
items.simple: Eat or finish all of something, quickly and happily.
dialogue: A: Where's the rest of the cake?
B: Dad decided to polish off the last bit.
items.note: Yemek için ama iş için de: 'polish off the report'.

items.example: I need ten minutes to psych myself up before a big call.
items.exampleTr: Büyük bir görüşmeden önce kendimi hazırlamak için on dakikaya ihtiyacım var.
items.simple: Tell yourself you can do it, so you feel ready and brave.
dialogue: A: You've been staring at that door for ages.
B: I know. You've got to psych yourself up to ask for a raise.
items.note: 'yourself' kişiye göre değişir: myself, himself...

items.example: She can rattle off every capital city in Europe.
items.exampleTr: Avrupa'daki bütün başkentleri bir çırpıda sayabiliyor.
items.simple: Say a long list very fast, without stopping to think.
dialogue: A: Do you know all the passwords?
B: Yeah, I can rattle off the lot.
items.note: Liste, isim, rakam sayarken; etkileyici ya da umursamaz bir hız.

items.example: We really need to rein in our spending this month.
items.exampleTr: Bu ay harcamalarımızı gerçekten dizginlememiz lazım.
items.simple: Stop something from going too far, like pulling a horse to slow it.
dialogue: A: Another takeaway?
B: I know, I know, I need to rein in the takeaways.
items.note: Harcama, öfke, kontrolden çıkan biri için.

items.example: Can you sound out the boss before I ask officially?
items.exampleTr: Ben resmen sormadan önce patronun ağzını arar mısın?
items.simple: Gently ask someone what they think, before you really ask.
dialogue: A: Do you think Mark would join the team?
B: Not sure. Let me sound out his manager first.
items.note: 'sound someone out' de denir; burada bölünmemiş hali.

items.tr: (bir konuya) sıkı çalışmak, inek gibi çalışmak
items.example: I need to swot up on Spanish before the trip.
items.exampleTr: Geziden önce İspanyolcaya sıkı çalışmam lazım.
items.simple: Study a topic hard and fast, usually before a test.
dialogue: A: You know a lot about wine all of a sudden.
B: I had to swot up on it for the dinner party.
items.note: İngiliz İngilizcesi, gayriresmî. ABD'de 'bone up on'.

items.example: He always finds a way to wriggle out of washing up.
items.exampleTr: Bulaşıktan sıyrılmanın hep bir yolunu buluyor.
items.simple: Find a sneaky way not to do something you should do.
dialogue: A: Is Tom helping us move on Saturday?
B: He'll try to wriggle out of it, trust me.
items.note: Kurnazca kaçmak; 'weasel out of' ile yakın.

items.example: Give me ten minutes and I'll whip up some pasta.
items.exampleTr: On dakika ver, hemen bir makarna yapayım.
items.simple: Make something to eat very quickly.
dialogue: A: I'm starving and there's nothing in.
B: Don't worry, I can whip up an omelette.
items.note: 'whip up support/anger' = desteği/öfkeyi körüklemek.

items.example: Dad said he'd spring for dinner tonight.
items.exampleTr: Babam bu akşamki yemeği kendisinin ödeyeceğini söyledi.
items.simple: Pay for something, often for other people, as a treat.
dialogue: A: Should we get the cheap seats?
B: Come on, let's spring for the good ones.
items.note: Amerikan İngilizcesi, gayriresmî; İngiltere'de 'stump up' benzeri.

items.example: Let me see if I can rustle up something for lunch.
items.exampleTr: Bakayım, öğle yemeği için bir şeyler ayarlayabilir miyim.
items.simple: Quickly find or make something with what you have.
dialogue: A: We need two more people for the quiz team.
B: I'll rustle up a couple of mates.
items.note: Yemek, para, yardımcı bulmak için; 'whip up'tan daha doğaçlama.

items.example: Another company is trying to muscle in on our clients.
items.exampleTr: Başka bir şirket müşterilerimize çökmeye çalışıyor.
items.simple: Push your way into something that belongs to other people.
dialogue: A: Why is Gary at our meeting?
B: He wants to muscle in on our project.
items.note: Olumsuz; iş, sohbet, fırsat için.

items.example: He spent all weekend poring over the holiday brochures.
items.exampleTr: Bütün hafta sonunu tatil broşürlerini inceleyerek geçirdi.
items.simple: Look at something very carefully for a long time.
dialogue: A: Have you signed the contract?
B: Not yet. I want to pore over it first.
items.note: 'pour over' diye yazılmaz! Harita, belge, fotoğraf için.

items.example: I managed to rack up a huge phone bill in Spain.
items.exampleTr: İspanya'da kocaman bir telefon faturası biriktirdim.
items.simple: Get more and more of something, like points or bills.
dialogue: A: How many air miles have you got now?
B: I've managed to rack up loads this year.
items.note: Borç, ceza, puan, mil, galibiyet için.

items.example: Her confidence has started to rub off on me.
items.exampleTr: Onun özgüveni bana da geçmeye başladı.
items.simple: When you spend time with someone and start to be like them.
dialogue: A: Since when do you go running?
B: I guess Jake's habits have started to rub off on me.
items.note: Genelde olumlu; 'Don't let it rub off on you' uyarı olarak.

items.example: Don't worry, you'll sail through the interview.
items.exampleTr: Merak etme, mülakatı çantada keklik geçersin.
items.simple: Pass something easily, with no problems.
dialogue: A: I'm so nervous about my driving test.
B: You'll sail through it, honestly.
items.note: Sınav, mülakat, ehliyet için cesaretlendirirken.

items.example: He's thirty and still sponges off his parents.
items.exampleTr: Otuz yaşında ve hâlâ annesiyle babasının sırtından geçiniyor.
items.simple: Live on someone else's money and give nothing back.
dialogue: A: Is your cousin still living with you?
B: Yep. He's happy to sponge off us forever.
items.note: Olumsuz, gayriresmî; 'sponge' tek başına 'otlakçı' da olur.

items.example: I think he's just stringing her along.
items.exampleTr: Bence onu sadece oyalıyor.
items.simple: Make someone hope for something you won't really give them.
dialogue: A: They keep saying the promotion is coming.
B: Sounds like they just string along anyone who waits.
items.note: İlişki veya iş teklifi için; 'string someone along' da olur.

items.example: She swanned off to Ibiza and left me with the kids.
items.exampleTr: Keyfince İbiza'ya gitti, çocukları bana bıraktı.
items.simple: Go off to have fun while other people do the work.
dialogue: A: Where's Phil?
B: He decided to swan off to lunch at eleven.
items.note: İngiliz İngilizcesi, sitemli ve alaycı.

items.example: We've whittled down the list to three flats.
items.exampleTr: Listeyi eleye eleye üç daireye indirdik.
items.simple: Make a list or number smaller, bit by bit.
dialogue: A: Have you picked a wedding venue?
B: We're trying to whittle down the options.
items.note: Aday, seçenek, borç sayısını azaltırken.

items.example: He'll waffle on for ages if you let him.
items.exampleTr: İzin verirsen saatlerce lafı dolandırır.
items.simple: Talk for a long time without saying anything useful.
dialogue: A: How was the meeting?
B: Long. Steve likes to waffle on about nothing.
items.note: İngiliz İngilizcesi; 'Sorry, I'm waffling' diye kendini de eleştirebilirsin.
